constraints_found.line: SUSHI. way too hot out for anything warm. let's do it!!
sushi yes. fancy sushi no. one dollar sign max, the trip fund is non-negotiable
Sushi works for me. One rule, as always: I'm allergic to peanuts. Some rolls come with peanut sauce or crushed peanuts on top, so please check.

constraints_found.constraint: Strict diet: vegetarian, needs proper vegetarian rolls, not just a side (deal-breaker)
constraints_found.line: mina. you're vegetarian. rice and edamame is a side, not a lunch (maya); confirmed by mina: ...okay. a few veggie rolls to choose from would be really nice. thank you both

constraints_found.constraint: Intolerance: dairy, nothing creamy (costs one star)
constraints_found.line: ok i'm so ready. oh, small thing, nothing creamy in mine pls. dairy and i don't get along

venue_reasoning.downtown_koi_counter: Sushi, $, no peanuts, no dairy at all, a full meat-free roll section. Meets everything: 3 stars.
venue_reasoning.downtown_kumo_bar: Peanuts on half the rolls and peanut sauce with every set. Allergy deal-breaker.
venue_reasoning.downtown_silver_reed: Fish in every roll, nothing vegetarian. Strict-diet deal-breaker.
venue_reasoning.downtown_hinoki_table: Cream cheese and creamy mayo on nearly everything, veggie rolls included. Dairy intolerance costs a star: 2 stars.
venue_reasoning.downtown_cedar_line: Meets every diet need but is $$, one tier over budget. Costs a star: 2 stars.

notes: Mina tries to hide her need ('i'm easy... rice and edamame'), and Maya reveals she is vegetarian. That is a nice touch, and Mina's follow-up line confirms it, so it is fair.
Each decoy fails exactly one constraint, and the reviews say so plainly. Once all five constraints are listed, the answer is clear. It is a good fit for a mid-campaign level, but slightly obvious.

Every venue is sushi, so the craving does not narrow the field. Roxy's 'too hot for anything warm' did not separate any venue (Silver Reed's fish-stock miso is the only warm item mentioned, and it is already out for the vegetarian rule).
Cedar Line's price shows as $$ on the card, and a review also hints at it ('a clear step up in price'). That is consistent.
